listings.headline: A move-in-ready 1938 brick ranch in St. Nicholas / South Shores
listings.summary: Charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath brick ranch in Jacksonville's desirable St. Nicholas/South Shores neighborhood. Original hardwood floors and doors, an updated kitchen with newer appliances, an updated bathroom, and a new A/C installed in 2023. The fully fenced backyard has a new deck and outdoor fireplace area; a detached workshop/garage provides flexible space for storage, hobbies, or a home office, and the crawl space is fully encapsulated.
listings.positioning: Minutes from San Marco, downtown Jacksonville, shopping, dining, medical centers, and major roadways. Detached carport, wood-burning fireplace, central heat; dishwasher, dryer, electric range, microwave, refrigerator, and washer convey.

listings.headline: A storefront condo in the 1884 City Mart Building, one block off Centre Street
listings.summary: Unit B of the historic City Mart Building — 1,511 square feet of ground-level commercial space with double glass doors and breezeway access, in the heart of the Fernandina Beach historic district. C-3 zoning keeps nearly every downtown use on the table.
listings.positioning: For the owner-user who wants a permanent address in the historic district, or the investor who wants downtown Fernandina retail frontage in a building that has anchored the block since 1884.
